# xray-rust

> An embeddable Rust client core for a documented subset of Xray configurations. The native SDK provides Apple and Android tunnel adapters. Kotlin Multiplatform apps can share profile import and tunnel control between Android and iOS.

## Integration

- [Core repository](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust) and [0.10.1 compatibility guide](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust/blob/v0.10.1/docs/config-compatibility.md). The release uses Xray-core v26.11.9 as its reference.
- [Native mobile SDK](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust-mobile). Pin the Swift package to 0.10.1 or add io.github.aimalygin:xray-rust-mobile:0.10.1 from Maven Central.
- [Kotlin Multiplatform setup](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust-kmp/tree/v0.10.1#use-it-in-your-project). Build the KMP library from tag v0.10.1 as a Gradle composite build. It wraps the native SDK and targets Android and iOS.
- [Core release and device evidence](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust/releases/tag/v0.10.1), [native SDK binaries and checksums](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust-mobile/releases/tag/v0.10.1), [KMP source release](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust-kmp/releases/tag/v0.10.1). The native SDK pins core commit 3cef7c42c2fd296afd27ab0b6435c632842e1a26 and C ABI 1.17.
- [Published benchmark](https://github.com/aimalygin/xray-rust/blob/v0.9.0/docs/benchmarks/results/2026-10-30-v26.10.21-three-engine/README.md). Localhost comparison from 2026-10-30 at core commit 123b9d8d.
- [Full project reference](https://xray-rust.aimalygin.chatgpt.site/llms-full.txt). Platforms, protocols, integration and release limitations.

The project is independent of XTLS and Xray-core and uses the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
